intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：北京时间08:06–08:15已实际尝试12路信源。HF今日榜未就绪；API提示开放至11/08，但显式请求11/09成功取得31篇，比昨日快照增加23个晚到成员，全部对账，未照搬过时的开放日提示。新增42个稳定ID（来源38项、已有issue补入4项）完成来源、范围与独立交叉审查：8项支持限定Harness范围、33项排除、1项待补。CPU-ARC按实际HF推荐日补回11/09，其他通过项均是较早来源，单列历史补录。另处理8项旧积压：6项通过范围及定性摘要复核、Evolver排除Harness、Cache Engineering仍缺具体演化版本证据；合计13项历史补录进入本周审核记录，不算今日新论文。三路arXiv查询成功且窗口内为0；五路RSS取得50条窗口记录；GitHub检查13个仓库，窗口内release为0。S2引文取得311条窗口记录（278个去重ID），匿名限流及单路180秒采集窗口使引文与作者覆盖未完成，未取得部分未知。8项历史来源阻塞经16次免费重试仍缺所需正文。新增付费生成请求为0。本期是采集与审核快照简报，不是新增论文日报，也不能据此断言全天没有更新。
intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 08:06–08:15 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready. Its API reported availability through Nov 8, but an explicit Nov 9 request succeeded with 31 papers, including 23 late additions; the full board was reconciled rather than relying on the stale availability hint. Forty-two new stable identities (38 source discoveries and four existing issue-only records) received source, scope and independent cross-review: eight support narrowly defined Harness scope, 33 are excluded, and one needs more evidence. CPU-ARC belongs in the Nov 9 supplement under its observed HF recommendation date; the other qualifying records have older source dates and remain labeled historical backlog. Eight older cases were also processed: six passed scope and qualitative-summary review, Evolver was excluded from Harness, and Cache Engineering still lacks specific evolution-version artifacts. The resulting 13 historical backlog decisions are recorded for this week, not counted as new papers today. Three arXiv searches succeeded with no window results; five RSS feeds returned 50 window records, and 13 GitHub repositories had no window releases. S2 citations returned 311 window records (278 unique identities); anonymous throttling and the 180-second source traversal window left parts of citation and author coverage uncollected. Uncollected coverage remains unknown. Sixteen free retries of eight older source blockers did not recover the required bodies. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection and review snapshot bulletin, not a new-paper edition or a claim that no later updates exist.
